gen-fascinate-fs-rowan: Rowan reads friendly and bookish, with generous openings in every curve. Fascinate earns its keep when it's big and brief, its widely spaced letters pairing fat verticals with hair-thin diagonals.
gen-flavors-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Flavors is whimsical and commanding, with a towering x-height. Flavors does its best work shouting, while Be Vietnam Pro does its best work keeping curve endings well apart on a high mean line.
gen-flavors-fs-hind: Hind keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Flavors is the one to shout with, towering and whimsical, while Hind does the steady work, its curve ends never turning inward.
gen-flavors-fs-paquito: Paquito sounds confident and approachable, with caps barely taller than its lowercase. Over pages of text it should feel friendly and unhurried, while Flavors, thick as neon glass tubing, stays out front as the loud one.
gen-flavors-fs-quicksand: A towering x-height, like a stubby pencil stroke, defines Flavors. Quicksand takes over below with bulb-round lowercase and uniform bar thickness, so the loud heading and gentle body feel related.
gen-flavors-gf-abyssinica-sil: Flavors looks drawn with a single nib, whimsical and commanding, its diagonals matching its stems. And Abyssinica SIL softens it with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke thickness, tall through the middle of every word.
gen-flavors-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-nex: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors draws every stroke like thick wire. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next sits beneath with big-eyed lowercase and open rounds, so the page moves from shout to easy conversation.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Flavors keeps its strokes free of any swelling or thinning. Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails back and packs words into solid blocks, so the loud heading gets a tidy counterpart.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Flavors gives every stroke equal visual weight, diagonals included, and lifts a towering x-height like a stubby pencil stroke. Noto Sans Thaana has wide channels, so a generous size suits it.
gen-flavors-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Page after page it should hold steady and dignified, while Flavors, cut like laser sheet with a single stroke width, supplies the shouting.
